findings.summary: The upper temperature bound prevents fitting the NLL-minimizing temperature for strongly overconfident models.
findings.mechanism: Many held-out datasets with highly peaked logits and substantial errors require T well above 2.0; minimize_scalar returns the 2.0 boundary instead of the NLL optimum, leaving persisted probabilities materially overconfident.

findings.summary: The claimed well-calibrated test neither uses calibrated data nor asserts recovery near 1.0.
findings.mechanism: All labels are the argmax of logits with confidence about 0.79, so the NLL optimum is the lower bound near 0.5; the broad assertion accepts it and cannot detect failure of the required near-1.0 behavior.
